# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (for later Q&A; use instead of source text)

## BOOK 1 of 2: "OUT OF THE BLUE" by Bertrand W. Sinclair (Gutenberg #73542; first in Blue Book Magazine, July 7, 1927)

**Protagonist:** Rock Holloway, young Texas range rider, long-limbed, tanned, gray Stetson, buckskin gloves, rides sorrel horse **Sangre** (white star; sometimes "red horse"). Black pony carries his bed. Has a .45 Colt, rifle, reata. Educated back East (a father, "Steve Holloway," was U.S. marshal at Abilene; sister/family: mother, sister **Cecilia "Cissy"** who is 17 and marrying a **Brett** (son of Brett of B X near El Paso); uncle **Tom Holloway** (Texas ranger captain, "Long Tom"); cousin **Ben Holloway** (Ragged H, Milk River)).

**Ch I – A Retaining Fee (Fort Worth, April):** Rock visits **"Uncle Bill" Sayre** (tall, thin, ~60, Southern dialect, president of **Trinity Bank**; chalk "Holy" on door). Sayre: executor of estate of **Dave Snell** (Maltese Cross outfit, Texas, range on west fork of Trinity; ~30,000 cattle; moved to Montana, Marias River, headquarters near Fort Benton; post office Fort Benton). Snell's heirs: daughter **Alice Snell** (just 21), son (16); estate run until boy is 25. Co-executor **"Buck" Walters** (range boss; young, ambitious, high-handed, fond of women, flashy dresser, stiff poker, drew big wages 10 yrs, never kept a dollar). Sayre distrusts him; asks Rock to spy on Maltese Cross as "Bill Sayre personally." Pays $500 advance in gold bag ("retaining fee"), $60/month. Rock rides with **Seventy Seven** trail herd (Duffy outfit; boss **Elmer Duffy**; brothers **Joe, Ed, Mark**; Mark "big as a house," bully). Rock leaves Texas; sorrel at Trinity River.

**Ch II – In the Odeon (Clark's Ford, Nebraska, July):** Clark's Ford on Platte-like river crossing; saloon/dance hall **the Odeon**. Rock meets **Al Kerr** (Capital K, Judith Basin, Arrow Creek, post office Lewistown; little, gnomelike, ~5'4"; never killed anyone). Mark Duffy, drunk, bullies Kerr (lifts him onto bar, shakes him, shoots into floor). Rock intervenes with Colt; Duffy draws, Rock shoots and kills Mark. Kerr's riders help them out. Kerr invites Rock to Judith Basin. Rock leaves Seventy Seven (Mark was brother of trail boss Elmer).

**Ch III – The Steering Wheel (trail to Montana):** Joins a short-handed trail herd of **Steering Wheel** brand (wagon boss unnamed; Canada, Fort MacLeod, Old Man River). Winter in Canada at Steering Wheel ranch (Sweet Grass area; Old Man country). Boss **Dave Wells** (tall, thin, Texan, drawl "sho'"). Wells sends men away; herd of "doggies" (actually unbranded-looking, fresh-burned Steering Wheel). Rock leaves in June toward Fort Benton.

**Ch IV – A Dead Double (Marias River):** Rock helps cavalry packing mules near Fort Assiniboine ($5/day). Finds Parke ranch on Marias (TL brand, left rib): finds bloodstained saddle in stable. Meets **Nona Parke** (~21, dark hair, gray eyes, dark imperious face, deep throaty voice, education). Her baby sister **Betty** (3-4, yellow-haired, blue eyes, rag doll, calls him "Doc"). Dead man **Doc Martin** (her rider), who looks exactly like Rock; shot from ambush ("one shot") in river bottom ~"half an hour" before Rock arrived; Elmer Duffy suspected. Nona's father (dead; horse fell on him); mother died at Betty's birth; first on the Marias 4 years ago, cattle lost in winter. Rock stays the night. Bury Doc at sunrise near river by cottonwood, beside mother and father graves (Ch V, "Wrapped in Canvas," canvas shroud, no coffin).

**Ch VI – Very Adroit Rock:** Nona hires Rock at $50/mo (more than Doc's $40). Milks cows. Warns against sentiment ("every man who works for me gets the idea he's in love with me"). Half-breed girl nurse **Mary Vieux** (16, moon face; family down river). Elmer Duffy rides up; Rock poses as Doc Martin ("Hello, Duffy"); Elmer accepts, says Doc threatened him. Rock claims a shot was taken at him; Nona confirms she heard. Elmer's denial; he says "when I shoot at you, I'll be lookin' you in the eye." Rock lets Elmer think he's Doc, backs off jealousy. Nona: "Are you on the dodge?" Rock: wants to find killer.

**Ch VII – Mariners:** Rock sent to find Maltese Cross/TL cattle in Lonesome Prairie draw; meets Maltese Cross round-up at White Springs: **Charlie Shaw** (TL rider, ~20, blue eyes, blond, smiling, loyal), **Alice Snell** (yellow/tawny hair, pansy/purple-blue eyes, black brows, dimple, fancy green corduroy riding skirt, hand-carved saddle; "Alice Snell and a brother inherit"); **Buck Walters** (high-crowned hat with silver band, big, well-dressed, arrogant, cold). Alice calls Rock "Doc." Rock is "like the cat"—"mariners stranded on an island." Nona needs Rock; Rock admires her. Nona says Alice "detests" Buck; Buck is in love with Alice. Rock grows uneasy: Maltese Cross calves missing.

**Ch VIII – Getting Down to Cases:** Charlie says rumor Doc/Rock rustles with **Burris boys** (behind the Goosebill, a hill halfway Marias–Fort Benton); Buck wants to kill Doc over Alice. Rock shows Charlie the bloody saddle, reveals identity; Nona says Doc is dead. Charlie: Doc was "a white man." Buck threatened Doc: range bosses with ambitions. Buck has hard men (two hangers-on who never ride round-up). Nona asks Rock to go to Fort Benton for haying hands.

**Ch IX – Ordered South:** Fort Benton (oldest settlement, former Northwest Fur Company post; Grand Union Hotel; ferry; Bear Paws east; Judith Basin; Missouri). At the bar Rock meets **Dave Wells** (Wagon Wheel boss? also said Steering Wheel) and Buck Walters together; Wells recognizes "Rock Holloway," Walters says Rock is "Doc Martin." Night: Walters warns Rock: "Get out of this country... South... 48 hours" ("I will shut your mouth for good, inside forty-eight hours"). Walters: "my friend Dave Wells will kill you before you get it out." Rock nearly slaps him.

**Ch X – Thirty Angry Men:** At TL. Alice rides in panicked: Buck and Elmer Duffy with all riders (~30) coming to hang Doc for stealing cattle. Rock with rifle at door; Nona and Alice on porch. Rock reveals he is Rock Holloway. Nona says Doc is dead; calls accusation a lie. Charlie Shaw backs Rock ("Stand pat... two guns"). Elmer: "only one other man you could be"; Rock names Dave Wells' Fort Benton remark; Elmer says "You're Rock Holloway." Walters claims Burris thieves incriminated Doc; Walters leaves, "So long, boys!" Alice hates Buck ("blackhearted beast"); she says Buck killed Doc (Alice: "I know who did it and why"). Buck: "You were afraid of him."

**Ch XI – Riders on a Rise:** Nona and Rock talk; Rock "You steal hearts"; Nona: Alice to stay at ranch. Nona: "There will be an election in a month" (county organization: judge, sheriff, etc., Benton news). Rock to hay for two or three weeks. Charlie reveals Buck's men cleaned up Burrises; Charlie found the hidden corrals (Doc had mentioned them). Rock and Charlie ride to get work horses; ambushed in ravine behind spring (Buck's men, two shooters). Rock's horse shot; he kills first man (in brush); chases second on sorrel with Maltese Cross brand; shoots horse out from under him; captures him, hog-ties him. Second is **Joe Stack** (Maltese Cross horse); first is **Bill Hurley**.

**Ch XII – Stack Decides to Talk:** Rock wounded on scalp (bullet grazed head; bandaged by Nona with court-plaster, carbolic). Rock torture-tests Stack (singes foot). Stack reveals Buck offered $500 to kill Rock; Hurley shot Doc Martin. Buck is going North with hand-picked crew. Rock releases Stack on a Maltese Cross horse with blanket and grub; Stack heads south toward Fort Benton. Rock kisses Nona at parting (Ch XIII); "Sangre." Rock rides to Judith Basin.

**Ch XIII – On the Warpath:** Rock telegrams Uncle Bill Sayre (long telegram; Sayre reply: "Act on your own judgment. Will back any action you take. Suspected this. Coming north, first train. Sayre."). Rock goes to Capital K (Kerr), gets dozen riders (wagon, cook, wrangler, 100 horses). Fort Benton; Charlie Shaw joins with info: Buck camped on creek near corrals with six "pets" and five new riders from the North; corrals in Sweet Grass Hills, near East Butte.

**Ch XIV–XV – Hot on the Trail / Popping Guns:** Rock camps on East Butte (Sweet Grass Hills: Gold Butte, West Butte, East Butte). Sees branding: changing Maltese Cross brand to Steering Wheel. Buck and Dave Wells present. Lookout shoots Charlie (he falls over bank, wounded). Rock's horse shot; he runs pursuit; Buck charges at him on coal-black white-faced horse; Rock shoots Buck dead at 20 yards; the black horse falls on Rock, injuring leg and side.

**Ch XVI – "Certainly Not Sad":** Rock talks with Uncle Bill at Maltese Cross ranch; Steering Wheel schemed to rebrand stolen steers. Buck borrowed $25,000 for 1,200 head of Panhandle cattle. Sayre asks Rock to run Maltese Cross; Rock says he'll answer tomorrow. Visit to Parke ranch; Elmer Duffy there proposing to Nona; Duffy and Rock shake hands. Charlie Shaw shot but alive (sent to Benton in wagon). Rock tells Nona he likes her a lot; she cries; "two times when every woman cries... I'm certainly not sad!" [Transcriber's note: from July 7, 1927 Blue Book.]

## BOOK 2 of 2: "THE YOUNG NAVAL CAPTAIN; or THE WAR OF ALL NATIONS" by Captain Ralph Bonehill (Edward Stratemeyer), Thompson & Thomas, Chicago, copyright 1902; Gutenberg #75394; 30 chapters; preface: author's aims (naval science progress; American growth; opportunity for boys).

**Setting:** Imaginary future war, spring 1936. United States (President **Jefferson McKinley Adams**; descendant of John Adams) against the world. Secretary of the Navy **Short**. Admiral **Alvin Chester** (Pacific). Commodore **Garrison** (Cuban waters). Admiral **Fielding** (Gulf of St. Lawrence/Casco Bay). Senator **Forbish** (NY). Foreign navies: England, France, Germany, Russia, Japan, China (Yellow War 1925), Italy, Spain.

**Main characters:**
- **Oscar Pelham** – young inventor, ~20, black curly hair, piercing black eyes; son of late **Commodore David Pelham** (Standard Shipyard, Bridgeport). Builds submarine **Holland XI.** (aluminum/steel, 115 ft, torpedoes, dynamite bombs, "highite" shell). Later Captain; becomes Rear Admiral Pelham.
- **Andy Greggs** – best friend, 18, tall, blue eyes, curly brown hair, machinist; first lieutenant.
- **George Dross** – old engineer, Bridgeport; "by ginger."
- **Marney** (air man), **Walton** (ammunition man), **Gilson** (general helper), **Marney**.
- **Martha Adams** – President's only daughter; kidnapped from White House; brown eyes; held on Chinese cruiser **Green Dragon**; rescued by Oscar. Oscar shot in shoulder.
- **Mrs. Adams** (ill after kidnapping).
- **Gabretti** – Italian traitor who blew up first Holland (reward $50,000); captured at Santiago.
- **Lieutenant Raxtell** – mad lieutenant who tried to blow up Holland XI; bound with leather mask, put ashore at Boston.
- **Nathan Pargloss** – ex-Treasury official, traitor; planned blowing canal locks; drowned on stump in Central American canal.
- **Hang Chang** – Chinese captain, captured aboard the Corcoran; threatened Oscar; leapt overboard dragging Oscar; killed by Andy with knife.
- **Captain Gresson** – British captain of the Corcoran.
- **Captain Roquez** – Spanish captain who captured Holland XI at night (with Canelli, Gabretti); placed at Santiago.
- **Jean Fevre** – French dude rescued from wreck of Bordeaux.
- **Barton Peeks** – notorious British spy whose name Oscar used.

**Chapter events:**
- I: War declared; Andy & Oscar at Bridgeport; navy warship order; Oscar's submarine ideas.
- II: New York war march; Holland I blown up by Gabretti; fleet battle off Sandy Hook; German submarine sinks U.S. warships.
- III: Oscar meets Senator Forbish; interview with Secretary Short; demonstration model.
- IV: Model test; Holland XI commissioned; sinks Chinese cruiser **Tien-Tsin** off Baracoa, Cuba.
- V: French cruiser **Republique** shell; prisoners under sea; sinking buries Holland.
- VI: Oscar escapes in diver's suit; swims ashore on Cuba; Japanese capture.
- VII: Andy rescues Oscar; Japanese column bombed with dynamite.
- VIII: Sargasso Sea; Admiral Fielding; Commodore orders; Lt. Raxtell's madness.
- IX: Raxtell subdued; Oscar sinks German **Wilhelm II.**, British **Terrible**, French **Philippe**; highite ordered.
- X: Kidnapping of Martha Adams; fraudulent messages; mine in copper net; English despatch boat sunk.
- XI: Message code suggestion; anchor tangles screw; battle off Casco Bay; Holland XI called ("Come to Casco Bay instantly").
- XII: Victory turned: sinks British cruiser, French **Coronet**, German cruisers, Turkish, Italian ships; Chinese/Japanese/Russian fleet to Pacific; Alvin Chester summons.
- XIII: Central American Canal (cost $36 million); Pargloss' plot; drowned.
- XIV: Honolulu captured by foreign fleet; Oscar destroys eight warships with wire-triggered bombs; tidal wave strands Holland XI.
- XV: Chinese/Japanese/Russian ships on Hawaii; Holland XI shoots bomb; whale plays trap-door; Oscar kills whale.
- XVI: Lightning kills one man; Oscar saves American merchantman (two Japanese cruisers sunk).
- XVII: Oscar boards **Corcoran** as "Barton Peeks"; kills negro; Captain Gresson, Chinese captains.
- XVIII: Holland XI returns; Hang Chang captured; San Francisco; Admiral orders new fleet to Alaska.
- XIX: Hang Chang reveals Martha Adams is on the Chinese warship **Green Dragon** (sailed from Chesapeake to Cuba); Oscar threatens torture.
- XX: Pekin sunk at San Francisco; Tokio sunk after anchor entangles screw; Holland enters cave under ocean (landslide).
- XXI: Sea serpent killed by dynamite shell; lightning strikes Holland; Dross knocked out.
- XXII: Electricity chaos; Oscar stops the craft; Gilson helps.
- XXIII: Repairs; Russian cruiser **Ivan II.** and fleet at Cape Nome (gold/silver); Holland attacked by bomb (Oscar catches burning fuse, bomb explodes; Andy's cheek skin taken).
- XXIV: Ivan II. sunk by torpedo; 209 Russians captured including Admiral; Hang Chang leaps overboard with Oscar, Andy saves him.
- XXV: Holland XI captured at night by Spanish Captain Roquez (Canelli, Gabretti) near Cuba; Marney killed.
- XXVI: Oscar and Andy escape bonds; Gabretti runs engine.
- XXVII: Defeat of enemy; Canelli killed by electric rifle; Gabretti beaten; prisoners to Santiago garrison; $50,000 reward.
- XXVIII: Underwater volcanic earthquake (Caribbean); Holland escapes.
- XXIX: Frenchman Jean Fevre rescued from wreck of French ship **Bordeaux**.
- XXX: Green Dragon found in Cuban bay; Martha Adams saved; Oscar shot in shoulder; Chinese admiral killed; Holland torpedoes Green Dragon; war ends; President Adams names Oscar commodore. Two years later Oscar Rear Admiral Pelham; marries Martha. Andy and George Dross commodores of squadrons. "THE END."
